messages.content: Evaluate six claims using only the supplied evidence cards. Labels must be exactly SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, or INCONCLUSIVE. Missing evidence is not contradiction. Do not use prior knowledge to fill a missing producer-domain card. Assess guard Boolean decisions separately from complete function/query/runtime behavior. Return one JSON object with records: six objects containing id,label,rationale_en,rationale_pt_br,citations (list of supplied card IDs). Give one concise substantive rationale in each language, preserve code identifiers, do not add claims or prose outside JSON.
